name: Slave Princess
source:
Inseminating discipline of the queen and princess in the absence of the hero!!

You are the demon lord who destroyed their kingdom
while the hero was away. His wife, the queen and their
princess daughter are to be subjects for your inseminating discipline.

This game does not have any frustrating "games" before sex,
all you need is just choose your favorite sex partner.
Is your choice a mature married woman, an innocent virgin girl,
or BOTH of them? Choose straightforwardly, 
driven by your instinctual sexual urge to impregnate!
